perks.name: Terminal Velocity
perks.description: Final blows with primary ammo weapons grant your primary ammo weapons temporarily increased reload speed.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a Primary Weapon Kill:
+20 Reload Speed and 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier for Primary Weapons for 6 seconds.
Buff can be triggered by destroying "destroyable entities" as well as Constructs.

perks.name: Power Loader
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants Special ammo progress.
perks.exact:
Upon picking up an Orb of Power:
+6% Special Ammo Progress.
